title: MZ Mog Weather EX for MZ

posts.author: joanarevez
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I recently switched from RPG Maker MV to MZ, so I'm trying not to lose many of the plugins I had...
I found this weather plugin:
MZ – MOG Weather EX
(MZ) Mog Weather EX Version v1.4 (2021/04/16) Adiciona novos efeitos de climas. Arquivos Necessários As imagens do clima devem ser gravadas na pasta img/weather/ PLUGIN COMMAND Utilize o Plugin Com…
mogplugins.com
But curiously, the download link is not working, it's redirecting to the general plugins page.
Does anyone have this plugin they could share?
Thankyouu!

posts.author: Krimer
posts.body:
MOG shares his plugins in the master demo. There are no separate links for individual plugins so just download the demo -
